name: rhmra-phone-share-worker
description: Encrypted, temporary, read-only phone snapshots for the RHMRA dashboard

scripts.test: node --check src/index.js && node --check src/viewer.js && node --test test/*.test.js

UPLOAD_TOKEN.description: A unique random secret of at least 32 characters used only by your local RHMRA dashboard uploader.

ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN.description: Your Cloudflare Access team URL, for example https://your-team.cloudflareaccess.com.

ACCESS_AUD.description: The Application Audience (AUD) tag shown in your Cloudflare Access application settings.

ACCESS_SERVICE_CLIENT_ID.description: The Client ID (common_name JWT claim) of the service token reserved for the RHMRA uploader.
